data.name: Derril
data.gender_notes: Derril is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'deor' meaning 'deer' and 'ril' meaning 'little one' or 'ruler'. This name may have been given to a child born while hunting or to one who was expected to rule. The name Derril carries the meaning “Little one, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Derril usually hope their child will grow to embody little one, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Derril belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little one, ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Derril total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.name: Derril
in_english.meaning: Derril means 'oak tree' or 'strong and powerful'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Derril is of English origin, derived from the Old English words 'der' meaning 'oak tree' and 'ril' meaning 'strong and powerful'. It is associated with strength, courage, and resilience. While not directly mentioned in the Bible, the symbolism of the oak tree represents endurance and faithfulness, values highly regarded in Christian tradition.
